events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969 in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Summer of Love Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, half a million people descended on a dairy farm in upstate New York for three days of peace, love, and music. What's your favourite memory or track from Woodstock '69?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away. He would have been 91.

angles.name: King's Legacy
angles.copy: 49 years since we lost the King. Elvis Presley's music and influence are still as powerful today. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in Las Vegas. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Hip Hop Icon
angles.copy: 30 years ago, hip hop lost a legend. Remembering Tupac Shakur and his incredible impact on music and culture. What's your favourite Tupac track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: On this day in 1970, guitar icon Jimi Hendrix passed away. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: 56 years ago, we lost a true pioneer. Remembering Jimi Hendrix, whose revolutionary guitar playing continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: Abbey Road album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969, and in the US on October 1, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is one of the most famous in history, but what's your top track from the record?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude have defined The Pretenders for decades. What's your favourite song from the band?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to Liam Gallagher – the voice of a generation and a true rock 'n' roll star. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic single 'Imagine' in the US on October 11, 1971, and in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: Timeless Anthem
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. A song that continues to resonate with its powerful message of peace and unity. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod on October 23, 2001, which then became available for purchase on November 10, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Music
angles.copy: Remember when you could fit 1,000 songs in your pocket? 25 years ago, the original iPod changed how we listened to music forever. What was on your first iPod?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global celebration of the James Bond film franchise, marking the release date of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, 007 has it all. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best Bond song?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent of John Lennon. His music continues to inspire and provoke thought. What's your most cherished Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is unmatched. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonders
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. Its eclectic mix still sparks debate and delight. What's your standout track from this double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, Queen's iconic frontman Freddie Mercury passed away. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Queen's Legend
angles.copy: 35 years since the music world lost Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and songwriting remain legendary. What's your favourite Freddie performance?

events.title: Rubber Soul album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed boundaries and influenced countless artists. What's your favourite track from this classic?
